unit_description: This unit develops the meaning of numerators and denominators. Students understand what each part of a fraction represents, represent fractions with fraction bars, area models, and stories, and name fractions accurately.
unit_goals: Represent fractions with area models and stories.

weeks.weekly_focus: Students learn the meaning of the numerator and denominator and represent fractions with models and stories.

lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by counting shaded parts of partitioned shapes.
lessons.concept: The numerator of a fraction tells how many equal parts are being counted or shaded. It is the top number. In 3/4, the numerator 3 means 3 parts are shaded.
lessons.practice: Identify and write numerators for shaded parts of models.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Warm up by counting shaded parts.

questions.prompt: A shape is divided into 4 equal parts. 3 are shaded. What is the numerator?
A shape has 5 equal parts. 2 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?

questions.hint: The numerator is the top number.

learn.title: What the Numerator Represents
teaching_points: The numerator is the top number.
It counts the parts you are talking about.
It can be shaded, chosen, or eaten.

example.prompt: A circle is divided into 6 equal parts. 2 parts are shaded. What is the fraction?

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: A rectangle is divided into 8 equal parts. 5 are shaded. What is the numerator?

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Write the numerator for each shaded model.

bigIdea.title: What the Numerator Represents
bigIdea.subtitle: The numerator counts the parts
bigIdea.intro: The numerator is the top number of a fraction. It tells how many parts you are looking at or counting.

ruleCards.description: The top number tells how many parts are shaded or counted.
For models, count the shaded parts to find the numerator.

lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by counting the total number of equal parts in shapes.
lessons.concept: The denominator is the bottom number of a fraction. It tells the total number of equal parts the whole is divided into. In 3/4, the denominator 4 means 4 equal parts.
lessons.practice: Identify and write denominators for partitioned models.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Warm up by counting total parts.

questions.prompt: A shape is divided into 7 equal parts. What is the denominator if some are shaded?

questions.hint: The denominator is the bottom number.

questions.prompt: A shape has 4 equal parts. What is the denominator?

learn.title: What the Denominator Represents
teaching_points: The denominator is the bottom number.
It tells the total number of equal parts.
It names the size of each part.

example.prompt: A circle is divided into 5 equal parts. 2 are shaded. What is the denominator?

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: A rectangle is divided into 6 equal parts. 1 is shaded. What is the denominator?
try_it.hint: Count the total number of equal parts.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Write the denominator for each partitioned model.

bigIdea.title: What the Denominator Represents
bigIdea.subtitle: The denominator names the total parts
bigIdea.intro: The denominator is the bottom number of a fraction. It tells how many equal parts the whole has been split into.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: What does the denominator tell you about the size of each part?

ruleCards.description: The bottom number tells how many equal parts make the whole.
For models, count all equal parts to find the denominator.

lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by shading fraction bars to match fractions.
lessons.concept: A fraction bar is a rectangle divided into equal parts. Shade the number of parts shown by the numerator. The total number of parts is the denominator.
lessons.practice: Shade fraction bars and write the matching fraction.

questions.prompt: Shade 2/5 of a fraction bar with 5 equal parts.
A fraction bar has 4 parts. 3 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
Shade 5/8 of a fraction bar with 8 equal parts.

learn.title: Represent Fractions with Fraction Bars
teaching_points: Draw a bar with the same number of parts as the denominator.
Shade the number of parts shown by the numerator.
The fraction names the shaded amount.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Shade the fraction bar to match each fraction.

bigIdea.title: Represent Fractions with Fraction Bars
bigIdea.subtitle: Shade parts to show the fraction
bigIdea.intro: A fraction bar is a model that shows a fraction. The number of parts in the bar is the denominator. The number of shaded parts is the numerator.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: How is a fraction bar like a fraction?

ruleCards.description: Divide the fraction bar into the denominator number of parts.
Shade the numerator number of parts.

lessons.lesson_title: Represent Fractions with Area Models and Stories
lessons.fact_drill: Warm up by telling fraction stories for shaded shapes.
lessons.concept: Fractions can be shown with area models like circles and rectangles, and they can be described with stories. 3/4 can mean 3 out of 4 equal slices of pizza.
lessons.practice: Represent fractions with area models and write fraction stories.
lessons.objective: Represent fractions with area models and stories.

questions.prompt: A pizza is cut into 6 equal slices. 2 are eaten. What fraction is eaten?
A chocolate bar has 8 equal pieces. 5 are left. What fraction is left?
Shade an area model to show 3/5.

learn.title: Represent Fractions with Area Models and Stories
teaching_points: Area models show fractions as parts of a shape.
Stories use fractions to describe real things.
The numerator is the part; the denominator is the whole.

example.prompt: Write a story for 3/8 and show it with an area model.
example.equation: A granola bar cut into 8 pieces, 3 pieces eaten

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: Write a story for 4/6 and draw an area model.

practice_block.title: Practice Time
practice_block.instructions: Draw an area model and write a story for each fraction.

flashcards.title: Fraction Stories and Models
flashcards.instructions: Review fraction area models and stories.

bigIdea.title: Represent Fractions with Area Models and Stories
bigIdea.subtitle: Fractions describe parts in many ways
bigIdea.intro: Fractions can be shown with shapes or told in stories. Both the numerator and denominator have the same meaning: parts counted over total equal parts.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: How is a fraction story like an area model?

ruleCards.description: The shaded area shows the fraction.
A story can describe the same fraction.

lessons.fact_drill: Rapid review of numerator meaning, denominator meaning, fraction bars, and area models/stories.
lessons.concept: Review the four big ideas from this unit: what the numerator represents, what the denominator represents, representing fractions with fraction bars, and representing fractions with area models and stories.
lessons.practice: Complete a balanced evaluation covering the skills from this unit.
lessons.objective: Show what you know about naming fractions.

warmup.title: Luma Charge
warmup.instructions: Get ready to show what you know.

questions.prompt: A fraction bar is divided into 5 parts. Shade 2. What fraction is shaded?

learn.title: Ready to Show What You Know
teaching_points: Use any strategy that helps you.

example.prompt: You have learned four big ideas this unit.
example.equation: numerator + denominator + fraction bars + area models/stories = naming fractions

try_it.title: Try one together
try_it.prompt: A circle is divided into 6 equal parts. 4 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?

practice_block.title: Unit Evaluation
practice_block.instructions: Answer all questions carefully to show your understanding.

flashcards.title: Unit 27 Review
flashcards.instructions: Review key terms from Unit 27 before the evaluation.

bigIdea.title: Unit Evaluation: Naming Fractions
bigIdea.subtitle: Show what you know
bigIdea.intro: This evaluation checks your understanding of the four big ideas from this unit: the meaning of the numerator, the meaning of the denominator, fraction bars, and area models and stories.
bigIdea.bigQuestion: What do you know about numerators and denominators?

ruleCards.description: The denominator tells the total number of equal parts.
